title: Candidate changes for the designer, on top of board (docs/decisions.md, Open); nothing here is decided

overrides.why: Five event cards add 2 cubes per player, card or unit; with cube strength 1 and no refusal bell the Royal Army still takes most colonies (loyalist wins 45-69% at 4 players)
overrides.table: El Dorado Rumors: the Royal Army gains 1 cube per player, not 2. Mutiny, Boston Tea Party, Pirate Blockade, Black Market: 1 cube instead of 2 for each refusal, unit or seller. / Слухи об Эльдорадо: королевская армия получает 1 кубик за игрока, а не 2. Роптание в гарнизоне, Бостонское чаепитие, Пиратская блокада, Чёрный рынок: 1 кубик вместо 2 за каждый отказ, товар или продавца.

overrides.why: Raids start at hostility 4 of 5, so one hostile neighbour raids every activation
overrides.table: Natives raid only at hostility 5 (the last box of the track). / Туземцы совершают набег только при враждебности 5 (последняя клетка шкалы).

overrides.why: Players gain 0.14 ✝️ a game: a chapel must be worked for 1 ✝️ while a recruit costs the round number
overrides.table: Chapel and church are not worked: at the end of every round, each player gains the ✝️ of the best one they own (chapel 1, church 3). / Часовня и церковь не требуют работника: в конце каждого раунда игрок получает ✝️ лучшей из своих (часовня 1, церковь 3).

overrides.why: A second way to repair: a player whose ship is damaged can build the shipyard to repair it at once, wherever it is
overrides.table: Shipyard card adds: when you build it, your ship is fully repaired wherever it is. / Верфь: при постройке ваш корабль сразу полностью чинится, где бы он ни был.

overrides.why: Crops start at 3 and hardly move (3.5 sold a game): raw crops sell nearly as well as goods are worth to make
overrides.table: Market board: crops start at 2. / Рынок: сырьё начинает с 2.

overrides.why: Players make 7 crops a game between them, so the blacksmith shop (built 1.3 a game) is worked 0.2 times; timber is plentiful (38 a game)
overrides.table: Blacksmith shop card: 1 🪵 → 1 📦. Factory card: 1 🪵 → 2 📦. / Мастерская: 1 🪵 → 1 📦. Фабрика: 1 🪵 → 2 📦.

overrides.why: Probe: is the input the obstacle to manufacturing? Blacksmith shop and factory make goods from nothing
overrides.table: Blacksmith shop card: → 1 📦. Factory card: → 2 📦. / Мастерская: → 1 📦. Фабрика: → 2 📦.
